name: Full Body Hypertrophy
description: Muscle-building on three full-body workouts a week for 12 weeks. Every workout trains legs, chest, back and shoulders, so each muscle is worked three times a week. Sets climb from three to four and the reps come down as the weights go up; week 9 is a deload. Take each set to one or two reps short of failure, and add weight when you reach the top of the range. Exercises marked optional add arms, shoulders, calves or abs for a longer day; leave them out when short of time.

phases.name: Accumulate
phases.description: Three sets of ten to fifteen to learn the exercises and build volume

phases.name: Intensify
phases.description: Four sets of eight to twelve at heavier weights

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: fewer sets and lighter weights, so you start the next phase recovered

phases.name: Overreach
phases.description: The heaviest block: four sets of six to twelve on everything
